task_type: cumulative public web product repair and release
requested_outcome: Implement all 41 accepted defects as root fixes across every affected VII world, verify desktop and mobile behavior, and publish one cumulative version only after every critical gate passes.
authorization_boundary: Local code, tests, packaging, production publication and post-public verification are authorized by the current request. Supplier facts, canonical database ownership, bindings, accounts, billing and unrelated production configuration must not be invented, migrated or changed.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request is explicitly cumulative and public.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every item and affected family needs exact-version natural-destination evidence; local tests alone cannot approve release.

lesson_bundle.reason: Most reported defects were observed on phones.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require first viewport, low-height, keyboard, touch and responsive transition evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: Arrows, sliders, filters, calendars and sticky actions repeatedly failed.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Inventory and exercise every visible control and expand one shared failure across its whole family.

lesson_bundle.reason: Availability, counts, filters and result ordering must remain one search contract.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: URL, query, chips, counts, cards, map and authoritative data must agree.

lesson_bundle.reason: Vacations are the accepted reference for other worlds.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Compare hierarchy, geometry and behavior across worlds on desktop and mobile.

lesson_bundle.reason: Broken, slow, duplicated and missing business media are in scope.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require approved identity, loading, crop, fallback and no-cross-owner substitution evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: Forty-four screenshots and the old VII product are approved failure/reference evidence.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Create component and responsive parity checks instead of accepting a similar first screen.

lesson_bundle.reason: The changes are highly interactive and stateful.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Test default, loading, success, error, reset, back, reload, low-height and mobile/desktop states.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A reported example is fixed while the same shared defect remains in another world.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Repair shared components and inventory all consumers before world-specific exceptions.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Affected-family matrix and desktop/mobile browser evidence pass for every consumer.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The UI looks repaired but availability, counts, reviews or amenities still disagree with the API.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Define one canonical truth model and add API contract fixtures including negative controls.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Search card, detail page, map and source fixture agree for all golden records.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Emulated mobile passes while iPhone or Android interaction still overlaps, locks or jumps.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Run real-browser touch, keyboard, low-height and responsive-transition checks and do not claim physical-device coverage without it.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: 390 and 430 pixel browser checks pass; real-device evidence is recorded or explicitly remains a release blocker for the affected issue.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A fast patch drops earlier gallery, nearby, holiday, currency, slider or accessibility work.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use the latest cumulative descendant and protected source gates; keep unrelated invariants explicit.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Protected ancestor/capability gates and targeted predecessor regression suites pass.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The candidate passes locally but the public version or retained older tab breaks.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Freeze one source, preserve predecessor assets, verify rollback, deploy once and retest the exact public identity.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Public version/build/source identity, live journeys, old-tab navigation and rollback readiness are evidenced.

affected_family: vacations, spa, events, hourly, attractions, trails, providers and holidays
search pages, semantic landings, near-me pages and place mini-sites
search state, filters, counts, ranking, availability, price and room allocation
cards, images, galleries, rails, arrows, maps, calendars, reviews, sticky actions and footer
desktop, 390px mobile, 430px mobile, low-height, keyboard-open, orientation and breakpoint transitions
supplier API, D1 snapshots, edge/document cache, R2/media delivery and CMS metadata
warm/cold load, success, empty, failure, retry, reset, reload, back and retained-client states

sources.label: VII platform source and release invariants
User supplied failure evidence
sources.source: 41 numbered requirements and 44 screenshots in the active Codex task

sources.label: Accepted vacation visual reference
sources.source: Current vacation search and detail family, subject to exact-version verification

midpoint_gate.trigger: After canonical data contracts and shared UI primitives are repaired but before all worlds are expanded.
checks: Complete dated vacation search with guests and multiple rooms
Mobile vacation detail with gallery, map, amenities, reviews and booking action
Event search and event detail with complete inventory, date, gallery, review and sharing

attack_questions: Can any query show contradictory URL, chip, count, card, map or availability state?
Can any visible image, arrow, calendar, filter, sticky action or share control fail in another world or viewport?
Can a supplier outage, stale cache, reset, reload or back navigation create a false availability or restore cleared state?
Can a prior-version tab or missing retained asset break after publication?
Can any one of the 41 requirements lack exact public evidence?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact public version opened and exercised on the narrowest affected URLs after deployment.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Requirement ledger maps all 41 items and shared-family consumers to passed checks, blockers or justified exclusions.

effectiveness.baseline: The user reported 41 defects across 44 screenshots after repeated partial releases; exact repeated-correction count is not yet normalized.
effectiveness.target: Zero known P0/P1 defects in the 41-item ledger at release, zero shared-family misses, and one cumulative publication with no rollback-triggering regression.
